paragraphs.text:
You stagger as the truth hits home: Norman has been possessed 
by the cannibal spirit of the North. He is a wind-walker!

Make a Sanity roll. If you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. To dash off into the 
woods, go to 304. To fight the creature, go to 301.
